scope: Editor rearrange highlight, secondary tool routing and refreshed arrangement sheet
changes: Dock rearrange highlight follows currentMode instead of being always selected.
Additional tools use one bounded scrollable sheet; crop, replacement and photo styling stay in their existing primary buttons.
Wait for the additional-tool route to finish its exit transition before dispatching a canvas or page-tool action; reject double actions and stale page/session results.
Arrangement rows stay open when selected and do not mutate z-order. Explicit edit button returns to canvas; arrows and drag handles commit order and preserve undo.
Ignore no-op drags and stale drag snapshots. Modal targets cannot rebind to a new draft that reuses the same page ID.
Existing 120px thumbnail requests use a 32-entry local LRU, cleared on disposal. Photo numbering is computed once per changed order instead of slicing the layer list for each visible row.
Keep lazy list construction, bound sheet height and adapt controls to large type, compact screens and dark mode.

checked: Single modal ownership and full dismissal before tool handoff
Fresh-layer opacity writes and stale callbacks
Stable selection order, explicit reorder and undo
Draft reset with reused page IDs
Rotation, large text and dark colors
Bounded thumbnails, lazy rows and disposed scroll listeners
After-close opacity callbacks are inert and reject a replaced editor notifier
review.limits: Native widget tests and source review cover behavior and bounded resource ownership. Device frame timing and live system memory were not profiled.
